sources.title: VladimirGav/gemma4-26b-16GB-VRAM-Uncensored
sources.snippet: Readme Gemma 4 26B Uncensored (IQ4_XS) - Optimized for 16GB VRAM Uncensored This is a highly optimized, Uncensored version of Google Gemma 4 26B, specifically tailored to run on GPUs with 16GB of VRAM. It uses advanced IQ4_XS (Importance Matrix) quantization to maintain high intelligence and creativity while fitting into a limited memory footprint.
